message:
Command `cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
import ctypes,ctypes.util,struct
lib=ctypes.CDLL(ctypes.util.find_library('lz4') or 'liblz4.so.1')
lib.LZ4_compress_default.argtypes=[ctypes.c_char_p,ctypes.c_char_p,ctypes.c_int,ctypes.c_int];lib.LZ4_compress_default.restype=ctypes.c_int
lib.LZ4_decompress_safe_partial.argtypes=[ctypes.c_char_p,ctypes.c_char_p,ctypes.c_int,ctypes.c_int,ctypes.c_int];lib.LZ4_decompress_safe_partial.restype=ctypes.c_int
D=100
buf=bytearray(D)
def be16(o,v): buf[o:o+2]=struct.pack('>H',v)
def be32(o,v): buf[o:o+4]=struct.pack('>I',v)
be32(0,0x00050000); be32(4,0); be16(8,1); be16(10,0); be32(12,16)
be32(16,0); be16(20,42); be16(22,50); be16(24,10); buf[30]=1; buf[34]=0xff
be32(58,66); be32(62,100); be32(78,8)
# pass at 66, holes at 70-73, fsmOffset maybe 24 if initialized would pass later, but sink at numRules/fsmOffset
# put zeros or valid after hole
src=ctypes.create_string_buffer(bytes(buf)); out=ctypes.create_string_buffer(D*2)
r=lib.LZ4_compress_default(src,out,D,D*2)
comp=out.raw[:r]
print('D',D,'r',r,'comp',comp.hex())
# test
obuf=ctypes.create_string_buffer(b'X'*D,D); rr=lib.LZ4_decompress_safe_partial(ctypes.create_string_buffer(comp),obuf,len(comp),D,D)
print('dec',rr,obuf.raw[:90].hex())
PY` executed with exit code 0.
